answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The thread of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the lotus of a task receipt, and the opal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
